# Tech Edu Byte

> > Tech Edu Byte is a professional technology platform covering software development, code sharing tools, cybersecurity, gaming news, and educational tutorials.

The site features a custom pastebin service (TEXT HOST) with syntax highlighting for multiple programming languages including JavaScript, Python, Java, C++, and more. It also publishes tech news, product reviews, and tutorials on topics ranging from cryptocurrency to hardware peripherals.

## Key Topics

- TEXT HOST
- Pastebin and code sharing
- Syntax highlighting (Prism.js)
- JavaScript, Python, Java, C++, C#
- PHP, Ruby, Go, Rust, TypeScript
- GraphQL and Docker
- React JSX
- Bitcoin and cryptocurrency
- VPN and cybersecurity
- HDMI/DisplayPort technology
- Code snippets and encryption
- Software reviews
- Gaming news
- IPTV platform

## Code Hosting & Developer Tools

- [TEXT HOST](https://paste.techedubyte.com/): Pastebin-style text hosting service with syntax highlighting via Prism.js

## Technology News & Articles

- [Tech News Archive - Bitcoin, HDMI/DisplayPort, Audio Technica](https://www.techedubyte.com/page/1698/): Tech news archive covering Bitcoin, HDMI/DisplayPort, and Audio Technica
- [Tech Articles - VPN, Security, Privacy](https://www.techedubyte.com/page/1718/): Tech articles on Windscribe VPN, Ivanti EPMM vulnerabilities, and privacy
